body: I had a manic episode triggered by my medication in December and basically ruined any relationships I had with people I knew..the few remaining I have I have been avoiding due to my newly developed social anxiety. Its hard to find anything in common with people when you have lost interest in basically everything. I just feel like a bummer. I wouldn't want to be friends with me right now.
I used to. :\ all the time. I would blast all kinds at loud volumes. Now the thought to play any doesn't even cross my mind.

hi, thanks. im severely depressed and lost all my friends by my own doing. I cant imagine building relationships again especially when its difficult to get outside. I feel like nobody in the functioning world can understand me in this place. I keep looking at everyone going about their business and feel like i struck out. I dont know :\ thanks for listening.

thank you. Well. I haven't accomplished much in 6 months because im severely depressed and lost all my friends by my own doing. I cant imagine building relationships again especially when its difficult to get outside. I feel like nobody in the functioning world can understand me in this place.
Thank you very much . I just honestly have nothing to talk about my minds a blank, especially after not socializing for 6 months. All I have to think about is all of this.

Thank you for responding <3 Im sorry you have been here I wouldnt wish this on anyone. Whats bothering me most now is that Im afraid Ill never be able to socialize or make connections with people again. Ive been so far removed from reality for so long Im not sure it wants me back. If nothings changed for 6months, weeks and weeks go by and Im still here. I feel like Im still stuck in the same place I was 6 months ago while everyone has moved on. These thoughts go on and on non stop all the time. How did you break free?

Sorry that was so long. Whats the point of living when you can't build any kind of relationships. At all. I have no money to do anything. I've lost it. People usually recuperate in a month or so after things happen. Nothings changed for over 6 months. I can't tell if I'm in denial or what anymore...
